question: Estimate the TAM (Total Addressable Market) for online doctor consultations in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: TAM (theoretical max if 100% addressable use it) or SAM (realistic serviceable)? TAM.
Include only video/chat consults or in-app prescription/follow-ups too? Primary consult sessions only.
GP/general consult only or include specialists, mental health, dermatology? All categories.
B2C consumer market only or include B2B (insurance, corporate wellness)? B2C primary, with B2B noted separately.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: addressable population × consultation frequency × average revenue per consult.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average primary care consults per person per year (online + offline): ~3-4. If even 50% shift online over time = ~1.5-2 online consults/person/year.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average revenue per consult: ₹250 (range: free with insurance to ₹800 specialist; weighted average).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Add follow-up pharmacy + diagnostics tied to consult (typical 2-3x consult fee in basket): ₹17,500 × 2.5 = ~₹44,000 Cr full TAM.

calculationFlow: Of these, addressable for online doctor consults (urban + Tier 2/3 with affordability): ~400M.
Average primary care consults per person per year (online + offline): ~3-4. If even 50% shift online over time = ~1.5-2 online consults/person/year.
Annual online consults at TAM = 400M × 1.75 = 700M consults.
Average revenue per consult: ₹250 (range: free with insurance to ₹800 specialist; weighted average).
Add follow-up pharmacy + diagnostics tied to consult (typical 2-3x consult fee in basket): ₹17,500 × 2.5 = ~₹44,000 Cr full TAM.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Add follow-up pharmacy + diagnostics tied to consult (typical 2-3x consult fee in basket): ₹17,500 × 2.5 = ~₹44,000 Cr full TAM.
